inspection: Actual full-sheet generation result and separate view_image inspected. Four primary and eight alternate concept panels.

contradictions.emeraldella: Top and lateral concepts agree on eyeless head, taper and long spine; illustrated plate counts are suggestive only. Freeze eleven trunk plates and two rings. Fine limb architecture is deliberately generalized.
contradictions.burgessia: Concept has an oval/pointed top-view shield and apparent tail segmentation. Resolve toward a broad semicircular shield with gently curved rear edge and continuous unsegmented spine per ROM. Surface facets are deliberate rings, not random triangular noise.
contradictions.tuzoia: Concept shows attractive plum palette and ridge but reads too much as a horizontal horseshoe shield. Resolve by standing the paired valves in YZ planes around X thickness, with straight top hinge. Soft parts are a declared genus-level composite, not T. burgessensis exact anatomy. Ridge and sparse spines carry identity; fine polygon network omitted.
contradictions.sanctacaris: Concept agrees on winged head, medium plate rhythm and broad paddle. Arm counts vary/overlap across concepts; freeze six paired frontal limbs and eleven trunk segments per ROM. Fine setae, detailed claw dentition and podomere counts simplified.
